terminalRetirement.finding: Finished checked brain before calling potentially yielding release, then cleared brain/FSM slots unconditionally inside that older outer branch.
terminalRetirement.implementation: Post-release isNil requires same brain, original job token and registry revision before clearing both slots.
terminalRetirement.limits: Only final slots; prior public terminal snapshot and ReleaseLocal internal state/policy/path cleanup remain separate review work. Physical replacement race and overhead unverified.

releaseContext.finding: ReleaseLocal reread live brain/state/baseline after scheduled early cleanup and could restore or retire successor records.
releaseContext.implementation: Capture original brain/navigation/baseline/job/epoch/registry. Optional expected FSM token refuses already replaced caller. Cancellation/own brain removal, group restoration, each vehicle cleanup and final local-state/baseline removal have original-context transactions. Own deliberate nil brain is allowed only while no successor exists and original token/epoch/registry/state/baseline remain. Operation cancellation uses captured navigation generation.
limits: Passage retirement now has separate episode/owner checks; active creation/row progress and same-value native provenance remain open.
Per-vehicle retirement calls have bounded native/receipt checks but aggregate crew/vehicle transaction cost unmeasured.
No changed speed/route restoration rules; existing exact leases/native/external/task/keepCrew safeguards retained.
Physical handover, HC, interruption and full cleanup acceptance remain open.

passageRetirement.finding: Revision-only cancellation could adopt a successor passage under the same configuration; retirement could delete changed episode after scheduled observation.
passageRetirement.implementation: Release snapshots corridor/bypass [revision,identity,started,deadline] and [brain,jobToken,epoch,registryRevision] before cancellation. Optional supplied receipts refuse different current episode/owner context, including a successor retaining the same episode. _retire atomically rechecks local group, original brain/owner context and current episode/key before result and passage/capture deletion. Own newly created episode refreshes only its expected episode key.
passageRetirement.limits: No geometry query or native command inside retirement. Empty optional arguments preserve administrative revision-scoped callers; actual runtime and active passage proposal/progress publication remain unverified.

passageProgress.finding: Active row observations mutated shared episode rows before authority recheck; bypass capture history published independently.
passageProgress.implementation: Copy entry and working rows; isNil admission checks local group, unchanged owner context/live episode/key and original rows. Bypass capture history must also match and publishes with accepted rows. Only admitted observations proceed to failure/complete reporting, retaining the existing terminal boundary.
passageProgress.limits: No added world scans/rays or altered checkpoint/hull/cap rules. Refusal returns inactive without deleting original work. Active episode creation, fresh geometry at delayed commits, reversed previously passed vehicles, caller cap behavior on refusal, and runtime/performance remain unverified.

passageCreation.finding: Episode construction published directly after scheduled work reads; a replacement brain/lead work/passage/terminal could arrive before publication.
passageCreation.implementation: Capture relevant lead-work key before constructing private proposed episode. Atomic admission requires original owner context, current uncancelled/unfinished matching brain configuration, empty episode slot, unchanged terminal/lead/work key, live original tail deadline, authored route/count/index, feature and Zeus/external checks. Bypass additionally checks route recovery gate. Only own admitted episode becomes current and refreshes expected key.
passageCreation.limits: No renewed deadline/geometry scan/native command. Work-key arrays copy top-level snapshots; deeper same-value provenance and changed geometry during delayed observation remain limits. Runtime refusal/cap behavior, reversed previously passed vehicles, physical navigation and measured cost remain unaccepted.

passageReversal.finding: Passed rows were counted permanently without rechecking hulls that reversed back before the whole column cleared.
passageReversal.implementation: Recheck each passed vehicle/crew locality/effectiveness/control identity and eight hull corners beyond the existing5m exit plane. A failed current-clearance check resets only copied passed flag and enters existing availability/geometry/cap logic; checkpoint/entry history and deadlines remain.
limits: At most20vehicles; eight corners per check, up to16 on a returning vehicle. No extra rays/world scans/native commands.
Does not certify fresh geometry at delayed publication, continuous navigation support or current native intent across identical values.
Actual reversal, mixed-column flow, caller refusal behavior and overhead remain unverified.

passageDeferral.finding: Refused observation used inactive result shape and could remove a passage cap or trigger passage-ended cleanup.
passageDeferral.implementation: Refused creation/row publication/retirement returns optional fifth field DEFERRED. Three live ConvoyTick consumption points exit before applying those results. Previously applied controls persist; existing brain schedule supplies next callback, with no new timer/retry budget.
passageDeferral.limits: No promise of new safety observation while yielding. Actual interruption, held-cap duration, mixed traffic and measured cost remain unverified; terminal/cancel-only callers ignore the result as before.
